transliteration: vanavāsam hi samkhyaya vāsāmsyābharaṇāni ca ।bhartāramanugacchantyai sītāyai śvaśuro dadau ॥2-40-15॥

translations.english: Fatherinlaw (Dasaratha) gave clothes and ornaments on the assessment of the number of years Sita was going to spend in the forest with her husband.
